title: I am so upset
body:
I use notes pretty much everyday, as every Apple user does. And don’t get me wrong for the occasional thoughts and to dos, it’s great. 

But oh my goodness. Using this app for iPad notes, (for uni studying), this app is horrendous. I’ve been studying and writing in one note for hours, (because I don’t like to split sections into different notes) and I just moved my finger up to scroll upwards and all the diagrams I drew, and hand made notes I made completely went all over the place. I now only have about half of the stuff I wrote. This is going to take me so long to redo. 

I will never use this app again for study notes. Come on Apple. Freeform does similar buggy things too.

title: LOVE it!
body:
I absolutely adore this App! I use it as a journal (graphic, audio, you name it!). It has really great ways in which you can organise your thoughts as well as great and creative ways to express them. I specifically love the organisations into folders and sub folders!

In the future, I would love to see something like the ability to archive certain notes, seeing only a deaired number of notes on the “home page”?

Another cool feature you could explore is the ability to interpolate a note? Like commenting on a note. You could also look at it as “replying” to a note. A way to add secondary information without changing the original note. This could be for more accurate time stamp information.
